description: A finite-arity relation is decidable if and only if it is \(\Delta_1\)-definable in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.decidable_iff_deltaOne {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop) :
  ComputablePred R ↔ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.DeltaOneDefinable R
